title: ieee80211: add a dissector for the protected EHT EML OP MODE notif
description:
This an action frame to update the EMLSR / EMLMR mode.
This adds partial support for this frame.
It is fairly hairy to parse it because of its variable format, so for
now, just parse the EMLSR part and leave the EMLMR part for later.

Note: this is not tested at all yet

This is a bitmap, meaning that it is in BIG_ENDIAN, but I couldn't find a way to let the engine know how to do that properly
for FT_BOOLEAN, you don't use BASE_DEC but the length of field (24 bits it this case)

I did that:

```
    {&hf_ieee80211_eht_eml_emlsr_mode,
     {"EMLSR Mode", "wlan.eht.eml_control.emlsr_mode",
      FT_BOOLEAN, FT_UINT24, NULL, 0x01, NULL, HFILL }},

    {&hf_ieee80211_eht_eml_emlmr_mode,
     {"EMLMR Mode", "wlan.eht.eml_control.emlmr_mode",
      FT_BOOLEAN, FT_UINT24, NULL, 0x02, NULL, HFILL }},
```

And it does look better, but I find it very confusing.
Why should I mention the size of the field in the parameter that contains the base?
Also, what's the meaning of the base for a BOOLEAN field.

Anyway, the link bitmap is still not right:

![image](/uploads/e3cc4346807c37d253a768b5989870a7/image.png)

hi @egrumbach, you don't need to set FT_UINT24 but only 24 

you can search other field using FT_BOOLEAN or look the doc https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/blob/master/doc/README.dissector#L176
